data.description:
31 consecutive scheduled runs failed over 7 days (latest run 41503532529, 2026-11-02 10:45 PST). tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py::test_reconciler_submodules_resolve_to_the_package_source fails because rebar.reconciler.classify is imported from .venv/.../site-packages rather than the checkout on the macOS full-suite job. Earlier fixes anatomical-arbored-oyster and trusting-arborous-oyster are closed. Acceptance: the scheduled suite passes on the next 3 runs.

Found by the 2026-11-02 read-only ops sweep (session a85e3cd3).
data.title: Scheduled mirror Test Suite fails every run: reconciler.classify resolves to site-packages on macOS full-suite job
